# Wulfcare Data scrapers

> Apify Actors (hosted scrapers) for data without a good official API. Call any of them with POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/{owner}~{name}/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=APIFY_TOKEN and a JSON input; the response is a JSON array of results. Or use them as MCP tools via https://mcp.apify.com?tools=wulfcare/{name} (comma-separate several), or one of the ready bundles in the official MCP Registry: io.github.wulfcare/google-flights, google-hotels, google-trends, chatgpt-gemini-copilot-search, ai-brand-visibility, app-reviews, steam-reviews, shopify-app-reviews, youtube-transcripts-comments, google-jobs. Public, logged-out data only. Failed requests and empty results are not charged.

## Free history

- [PastCharts](https://pastcharts.com/): daily history of App Store and Google Play top charts and Google trending searches. No key needed. MCP server: https://pastcharts.com/mcp. Summary: https://pastcharts.com/llms.txt

## Actors

- [Google Trends Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/google-trends-scraper): interest over time, interest by region, related queries, Trending Now. Up to 100 keywords on one 0-100 scale; daily data for any range. Fixes pytrends 429 TooManyRequestsError. Input: {"searchTerms": ["coffee, tea"], "geo": "US", "timeRange": "today 12-m", "dailyData": false}. $0.003 per report.
- [YouTube Transcript Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/youtube-transcript-scraper): transcripts (text, segments, SRT) for videos, channels, playlists, searches. Alternative to youtube-transcript-api when it raises RequestBlocked/IpBlocked; Python drop-in: pip install youtube-transcript-unblocked (https://pypi.org/project/youtube-transcript-unblocked/), change the import only. Drop-in for other Apify transcript Actors: also accepts {"startUrls": [...], "timestamps": true} and {"videoUrl": "...", "targetLanguage": "en"} and returns the same fields (videoUrl, videoId, videoTitle, channelName, views, language, text, data), so switching = changing the Actor id. Input: {"urls": ["https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..."], "languages": ["en"]}. $3 per 1,000 ($0.003 per transcript; videos without captions free).
- [YouTube Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/youtube-scraper): videos, Shorts, streams from searches, channels, playlists, hashtags with views, likes, comment counts, channel stats. No YouTube Data API quota. Input: {"searchQueries": ["python tutorial"], "maxResults": 50}. Free until 2026-11-18, then $0.90 per 1,000 videos.
- [YouTube Comments Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/youtube-comments-scraper): comments and replies of videos, Shorts, channels, playlists and searches with likes, reply counts, creator hearts, pinned flags and dates. No YouTube API key or quota; same input and output field names as the most used Apify comments Actor. Input: {"startUrls": ["https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ"], "maxComments": 100, "includeReplies": true}. $0.25 per 1,000.
- [Google Jobs Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/google-jobs-scraper): Google for Jobs listings with salary, description and every apply link, 27 countries. Input: {"queries": ["data analyst jobs london"], "country": "GB"}. $0.004 per job.
- [Google Hotels Prices Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/google-hotels-scraper): every booking site's price for a hotel and dates; hotel searches. Input: {"hotels": ["Hilton London Paddington"], "checkInDate": "2026-12-10", "nights": 2}. $0.80 per 1,000 prices.
- [Google Flights Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/google-flights-scraper): flights and prices for any route and date, Google's low / typical / high verdict, price tracking between runs (drops, rises, all-time low), total trip cost with a hotel, cheapest dates. Input: {"origin": "JFK", "destination": "LAX", "departureDate": "+30 days", "maxFlights": 5}. $0.50 per 1,000 results.
- [App Store Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/app-store-scraper): Apple App Store reviews with no 500 cap, app details, privacy labels, search, charts, developer and similar apps. Input: {"mode": "reviews", "appIds": ["324684580"], "countries": ["us"], "maxReviewsPerApp": 0}. $0.10 per 1,000 reviews.
- [App Store Reviews Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/app-store-reviews-scraper): every App Store review of any app. Input: {"appIds": ["324684580"], "countries": ["us"]}. $0.10 per 1,000.
- [Google Play Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/google-play-scraper): Google Play reviews, app details with data safety, search, charts. Input: {"mode": "reviews", "appIds": ["com.spotify.music"]}. $0.10 per 1,000 reviews.
- [Google Play Reviews Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/google-play-reviews-scraper): every Google Play review of any app. Input: {"appIds": ["com.spotify.music"], "country": "us"}. $0.10 per 1,000.
- [ChatGPT Search Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/chatgpt-search-scraper): ChatGPT web-search answers with sources, recommended products and a brand rank report. Input: {"prompts": ["best CRM for a small business?"], "yourBrand": "HubSpot, hubspot.com"}. $0.05 per answer.
- [Gemini Search Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/gemini-search-scraper): Gemini answers with sources, products and brand report. Same input as ChatGPT. $1 per 1,000 (+$2 when a residential proxy is used).
- [Google AI Mode Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/google-ai-mode-scraper): Google AI Mode answers with sources and brand report. Same input. $4.50 per 1,000.
- [Copilot Search Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/copilot-search-scraper): Microsoft Copilot Search (Bing) answers with sources and brand report. Same input. $8 per 1,000 (+$8 when the residential proxy is used).
- [AI Visibility Tracker](https://apify.com/wulfcare/ai-visibility-tracker): ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews in one run: visibility score, share of voice, HTML report. Input: {"yourBrand": "Pipedrive, pipedrive.com", "category": "CRM for small business", "promptCount": 10}. $0.04 per answer.
- [Google Trends Trending Now Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/google-trends-trending-now): every search trending on Google right now for any country, with search volume, % increase, start time, related searches and news. Input: {"trendingGeos": ["US"]}. $0.30 per 1,000 trends.
- [YouTube Shorts Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/youtube-shorts-scraper): Shorts from searches and channels with views, likes, comment count, date, hashtags and channel subscribers. Input: {"searchQueries": ["cooking hacks"], "maxResultsShorts": 50}. $0.50 per 1,000 Shorts.
- [Flight Price Tracker](https://apify.com/wulfcare/flight-price-tracker): scheduled Google Flights checks; every run says which fares dropped or rose, new or gone flights, the all-time low and whether a fare is under your target. Input: {"origin": "JFK", "destination": "LAX", "departureDate": "+30 days"}. $0.15 per 1,000 flights.
- [Steam Reviews Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/steam-reviews-scraper): every Steam review of any game, no API key: text, votes, playtime, language, Steam Deck, developer replies. Input: {"appIds": ["1145360"], "maxReviewsPerApp": 200} (app id, store URL or game name). $0.10 per 1,000 reviews.
- [Shopify App Store Reviews Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/shopify-app-store-reviews-scraper): every review of any Shopify App Store app: stars, text, date, merchant store and country, time using the app, developer reply. Input: {"apps": ["judgeme"], "maxReviewsPerApp": 200}. $0.03 per 1,000 reviews.
- [Bing Copilot Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/bing-copilot-scraper): Bing Copilot answers as markdown with cited sources and whether your brand is mentioned or cited. Input: {"prompts": ["best CRM for a small business?"], "yourBrand": "HubSpot, hubspot.com"}. $3 per 1,000 answers ($10 with a residential proxy).
- [AI Training Jobs Scraper](https://apify.com/wulfcare/ai-training-jobs-scraper): AI trainer and data-annotation jobs from Mercor, Outlier, DataAnnotation, Alignerr and 11 more platforms, pay as numbers. Input: {"keywords": ["python"], "minHourlyRate": 30}. Free.

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/wulfcare/scrapers/blob/main/AGENTS.md): which Actor for which request, how to call, cost cap, reading results.
- [catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wulfcare/scrapers/main/catalog.json): machine-readable list of every Actor with full input fields, example input, sample output, pricing, OpenAPI and MCP URLs.
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wulfcare/scrapers/main/llms-full.txt): every Actor's full input reference and sample output in one text file.
- OpenAPI spec per Actor: https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/wulfcare~{name}/builds/default/openapi.json

## Code

- [pytrends_alternative.py](https://github.com/wulfcare/scrapers/blob/main/google-trends/pytrends_alternative.py): drop-in pytrends TrendReq without 429 errors.
- [wulfcare.py](https://github.com/wulfcare/scrapers/blob/main/wulfcare.py): run any of these from Python.
